definition: Relating to inheritance arranged through a person's will.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: Krook’s being “continually in liquor,” and the testamentary prospects of the young man are, as usual, the staple of their conversation.
example_sentence: Great Aunt Joan's testamentary wishes included a hamster nobody knew about.
